name: nt2_totient_pow_sub_one_multiple
statement: (a n : ℕ) (ha : 1 < a) : ∃ k, Nat.totient (a ^ n - 1) = n * k
closed: ∀ (a n : ℕ) (ha : 1 < a), ∃ k, Nat.totient (a ^ n - 1) = n * k
informal: For a > 1, n divides φ(a^n - 1): a has multiplicative order exactly n modulo a^n - 1. (Stated with an explicit cofactor.)
type: ∀ (a n : ℕ), 1 < a → ∃ k, (a ^ n - 1).totient = n * k
